method.description: Same 40-product audit snapshot. Start at 100 and subtract documented constraints only; unverified terms carry no provisional deduction and block final validation. Results are optimistic conditional scores, not mathematical upper bounds because rubric and evidence can change. No new external verification. No firm score, promotions or affiliation. V1 midpoint differences measure both methodology and treatment of missing data, not improvement in product quality.

Q.label: Qualitative trading restriction without quantified sanction

R4.label: Explicit changes applicable immediately to existing accounts

P4.label: Permanent excess profit deletion, limited/high cap

L2.label: Material cap or fraction withdrawal limit

K2.label: Qualitative position/strategy restrictions with independent scope

X6.label: Severe split reduction / closure strike mechanism

X8.label: Cycle reward reduced to 10% or lost on cumulative strikes

method.extensions: Q,K,L,F,B,M,T,W,G,X,Z and H are suggested test-only low penalties not approved by owner. D severity, A and P chosen within V3 ranges. R4 applies only to explicit existing-account changes. No ordinary 14-day interval, min trading days, KYC, stages or standard anti-abuse deduction. 40%+ consistency zero. Cost not calibrated or verified comparably. All 40 require evidence before publication.
method.note: Avoid double counting related mechanisms; group cap and confiscation, strike and resulting split, subjective review and associated forfeiture. Source wording is not adjudication of unlawful conduct.
